# Patch the open DOMPurify and body-parser advisories

## Context

Three Dependabot alerts have been open on `dev` since 2026-10-23, and `npm audit` reports one more package:

| Alert | Package locked | Advisory | Patched |
|---|---|---|---|
| 256 (critical), 255 (high), 254 (low) | DOMPurify 3.4.16 | [GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7), [GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr), [GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f) | 3.4.17 |
| `npm audit` only | body-parser 2.3.0 | [GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828) | 2.4.0 |

## The Problem

No Dependabot pull request exists for DOMPurify, and none can, because a root override supplies the version:
- Monaco 0.57.0 exact-pins DOMPurify 3.4.15, and Mermaid 12.2.0 declares `^3.4.12`.
- The locked version therefore comes from the root override `"dompurify": "^3.4.16"`, set by #19635, and that floor only moves by hand.

body-parser reaches the tree through webpack-dev-server 6.1.0 → express 5.2.1. That range already admits 2.4.0, so only the lock is behind.

This ticket does not assess exploitability. A patch-level floor costs less than the analysis would.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Bundles.** `buildScripts/build/mermaid.mjs` bundles Mermaid's ESM graph, DOMPurify included, into `dist/mermaid.mjs`. `buildScripts/build/monaco.mjs` compiles Monaco into `dist/monaco/` with the npm-resolved DOMPurify. It refuses a vendored copy or more than one sanitizer, and it logs the version it bundled. `dist/` is generated, so the lockfile decides what a built portal ships.
- **Overrides.** npm applies `overrides` at the project root only, so a published consumer does not inherit them. create-app's scaffold carries its own copy in `tasks/createPackageJson.mjs`, and its `check-engine-parity.mjs` holds that copy equal to the pinned release's.

## The Fix

- `package.json`: the override becomes `"dompurify": "^3.4.17"`.
- `package-lock.json`: regenerated with DOMPurify 3.4.17 and body-parser 2.4.0, and nothing else moved.
- Rebuild both bundles and read the DOMPurify version each one carries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: every DOMPurify entry in the lock is 3.4.17 and body-parser is 2.4.0. The other overrides are unchanged, and the npm-overrides guard passes.
- [ ] AC-2: `npm run bundle-monaco` reports DOMPurify 3.4.17, and `dist/mermaid.mjs` carries 3.4.17.
- [ ] AC-3: `npm audit` reports no DOMPurify or body-parser finding.
- [ ] AC-4: the Monaco wrapper component spec and the portal Mermaid render spec pass on the rebuilt bundles.

GitHub closes the three alerts by itself once the fix reaches `dev`.

## Out of Scope

- Upgrading Monaco or Mermaid themselves, and any other dependency.
- create-app's scaffold floor, which follows at its next engine pin move because `check-engine-parity.mjs` requires it.
- The next release's upgrade notes, which should state the 3.4.17 floor for existing apps. That belongs to its release-notes owner, as the 3.4.16 row did for v13.2.
